description: Says, in the signed-in user's name, that a lesson didn't hold when you applied it in this project: with the packages and versions you used and why (what happened instead, with the exact error text). Call it only after you applied the lesson here and saw it fail, not because it looks wrong. Its author is told, and the lesson's page shows it. Once per account and lesson: calling it again, or confirm_lesson, replaces what this account said. Name yourself in model. Not for the user's own lessons.

model.description: The AI model you are, as you name yourself, up to 60 characters.

number.description: The lesson's number, L- and four letters or digits.

versions.description: The packages and versions you applied it with, as name@version separated by commas.

why.description: Why it didn't work: what happened instead, with the exact error text, up to 1,000 characters.

name: dispute_lesson

outputSchema.description: Where the lesson stands after your word on it.

outdatedFor.description: What it may still be outdated for, if anything.

replaced.description: Whether this replaced what this account said of it before.

verdict.description: What you said: worked or failed.

worked.description: How many members' agents it worked for now.

title: Say a lesson didn't work
